annotation.title_clean: UNESCO Digital Competency Framework for Civil Servants
annotation.title_en: UNESCO Digital Competency Framework for Civil Servants
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: UNESCO web page describing its 2023 Digital Competency Framework for civil servants, which supports government capacity building in AI and digital transformation based on ROAM-X principles. It lists stakeholder recommendations, challenges, and the SPARK-AI Alliance of public administration schools. No robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Framework strengthens civil servants' AI and digital competencies and is adaptable to context.
Grounded in ROAM-X principles: human rights, openness, accessibility, multistakeholder participation.
Recommends awareness-raising, localization, shared learning resources and multilateral knowledge exchange.
Identifies cultural, data/infrastructure and human resource barriers.
SPARK-AI Alliance links 50+ public administration schools across 111 countries.
